errors.what: Crank rotates clockwise instead of counter-clockwise: the panel angle decreases (330, 300, 270, ...) and the crank pin B moves below the X axis right after t=0, whereas CCW motion would put B above the axis (theta=30 deg at t=0.33s, 90 deg at t=1s). Piston x values match the formula for the displayed angle, so only the sense of rotation (and thus phase of the sequence) is wrong.
